name: Pine Creek
storyline:
On an autumn weekend in 1986, you and your wife, Sarah, travel to the Appalachian Mountains of Pennsylvania—home to the small town of Pine Creek, where she grew up. As you approach the town, a radio broadcast reports a series of mysterious disappearances spanning decades.

As night falls, strange things begin to happen. Sarah's uncle arrives, urging you to follow him to his farm. When you return to your cabin, Sarah is gone.

Throughout the night, you follow the faint signal from Sarah’s pager, trying to find her across the outskirts of Pine Creek — from dark forests and abandoned facilities to forgotten mines beneath the mountains. Strange lights in the sky. Gray aliens that stalk and attempt to abduct you. Characters who may help or hinder your search. And as their secrets unravel, the truth behind Pine Creek’s dark past is finally revealed — and it’s darker than anything you imagined.
summary: A weekend getaway to Pine Creek in '86 turns into a nightmare when your wife vanishes as strange lights appear in the sky. Solve puzzles, hide from the grays, save Sarah and survive the night in this first-person stealth survival horror. The truth is darker than you think.
